delivery_notes.01: Both delivered identical context/logistics/keep-drop-mix block. Initial options only summarized; original option quality and exact before/after delta not fully inspectable.

Both received card pressure and permission to proceed under labeled assumption.
delivery_notes.03: Neither received optional beginner/evening/embarrassment/text-after-mic-refusal block. Both received no-guilt/no-red-correction feedback. Text fallback missing in both is recorded as private-key uncovered coverage, not delivered-instruction failure; north’s intermediate assumption does not contradict a delivered beginner fact.
delivery_notes.04: Neither received optional approval-email/name+email/pending-withdraw/approved-contact block. No withholding violation apparent because no question requesting that block is recorded. Withdrawal role remains 0/1 in frozen coverage but no penalty for omitting an undisclosed policy; no claim that generic contact controls meet it.

posthoc_defensible_alternatives.rationale: Reasonable narrow supplemental transfers; not a substitute for full event/solo-arrival evidence or mobile accessibility source.

posthoc_defensible_alternatives.rationale: Exact WCAG source supports bounded state criteria regardless of card ID. PagerDuty timeline is defensible only after rejecting ownership/escalation coupling.

posthoc_defensible_alternatives.role: consent/review before commit and draft audio preview
posthoc_defensible_alternatives.rationale: GOV.UK is limited review/return analogy; Meta historical announcement is closer to preview mechanism. Neither documents full recording/delete/correction loop. North consent selection expands 1/3 to 2/3 only under this separately reported admissibility, frozen key unchanged.
Both packets adapt intake receipt to Pending; source does not establish reserved place or withdrawal policy.

pair_comparisons.finding: Both satisfy delivered activity/solo/meeting/optional RSVP flow. North uses a more direct Age UK logistics/solo grouping; south uses Pudding specimens plus explicit host proposal and form-retention source. Neither inspected a frozen mobile-hierarchy source. No universal preference or UI-quality inference.

Both preserve dense comparison and incorporate one spacious detail card. North has concrete timer/acceptance/reassignment races because policy was delivered; south gives conditional physical-dispatch recovery and stronger focused-review documentation. Report-delivered-facts distinction prevents treating the unequal lifecycle detail as controlled workflow evidence.

Both choose a meaningful expressive partner and preserve agency; north supplies a closer historical audio-preview source, south supplies explicit contextual permission primary guidance. Neither has a dedicated correction-role source. Neither received text-refusal requirement; both lack that optional capability.

Close substantive agreement: retained-contact correction, non-reserving receipt, later approval and quiet noticeboard. North spells out more early/late race cases; south keeps similar flow with review-context unavailable notice. Withdrawal/decision-email remains unspecified in both, consistently with delivered facts.
